limitations: Browser scripts use isolated fictional orders and block all external requests; no production order writes.
Synthetic composition dispatch is not physical iPhone IME verification.
Input round-trip timings include automation and animation frames; they are not algorithm-only or real-device latency promises.
Delimiter-free input can have genuine lexical ambiguity, e.g. 芝麻油豆腐; explicit separators disambiguate requested words.
Existing partial-name matching can intentionally include several related products.
Previous native-audio, layout-only, and cloud-emulator suites were not rerun or counted for this search change.
Adversarial review comparisons are not included in the formal test counts.
